Chapter 6947: Grand Momentum

Chapter 6947: Grand Momentum

Treasure and six more immortals stepped forward.

“Go!” Breaker shouted and real worlds emerged.

“Breaker Frontier.” Everyone recognized these worlds under his jurisdiction.

After many epochs, the destroyer still created a defense system made up of numerous firmaments fueled by worldly essences and life force.

He then handed the grand momentum to his underlings.

“Rumble!” Those firmaments shot forth a heavenly pulse, empowering the combatants.

Since these immortals were already mighty, their cultivation didn’t improve, only their battle prowess and vitality did.

Treasure stood in front while the others helped form a triangular formation behind him. They then also channeled their powers into him through the grand momentum.

This was more than just seven immortals combining power. The simple way resulted in stagnation and flaws in the connections. However, the grand momentum allowed a smooth flow without any conflict, boosting Treasure to almost the primordial stage.

A radiant flame engulfed him. As he conjured more power, he shook all of Heavenrealm.

“Breaker branch’s foundation.” Overlords and immortals withdrew from Treasure Immortal Realm.

The incoming battle would crush everything nearby. Anything below the immortal realm was going to be obliterated.

A primordial immortal was required to take down this grand momentum. This was the reason why Breaker Immortal’s branch survived all this time.

Other immortals, such as Apex and Heaven’s Equal, also came out to watch. They were surprised to see so much fanfare against a mortal.

“A mortal?” Apex’s heavenly gaze failed him when he tried to take a closer look.

Others shared the same confusion.

“Die!” Treasure became death incarnate after wielding his father’s hammer and being empowered.

“Zzz...” His firmament withered towards death. His very presence exuded death and killed other affinities.

“You may start first.” Li Qiye smiled.

Spectators gasped upon hearing this. Breaker Immortal and his two peers were also surprised.

The three primordial immortals wouldn’t have been so confident going against the empowered Treasure. Sure, they would win in the end, but it would be a challenge.

“Very well.” Treasure smiled and said: “I want to see what miracle you will pull off.”

With that, he swung his hammer with both hands.
